title: Troopr AI Scrum Master: Writes your standup from real work. Remembers your team. | Product Hunt
excerpt: Troopr joins your standup, writes each person's update from real Jira, GitHub, and Slack activity, and flags what doesn't add up. It builds a memory of how your team works, so every standup gets more accurate.
